question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Glad
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3. i.e. Sad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Glad (खुश)** - Feeling pleasure, joy, or delight.

 
 
• **Example:** She was glad to see her friend after a long time.
 
 
 
• **Sad (उदास)** - Feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy.
 
 
• **Example:** He felt sad after hearing the bad news.
 
 
 
• From above example it is clear that Sad is antonym of the Glad.

Therefore, the correct answer is- **Sad**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Keen (इच्छुक)** - Having or showing eagerness or enthusiasm.
 
• **Loyal (वफादार)** - Giving or showing firm and constant support or allegiance to a person or institution.
 
• **Pleased (प्रसन्न)** - Feeling or showing pleasure and satisfaction, especially at an event or a situation.

33:Tafd,

The correct answer is Option 1.&
